description: This file is a shell script used for testing the application of git patches with various options and scenarios, including handling directory renames, filename quoting, file mode changes, and patch application failures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.
methods.parameters: A label and a shell command string.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to verify error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that a pattern appears in the output of a command.
methods.parameters: A pattern string and command output.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Checks the permission bits of a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
